# Whiteheap

> Open-source tools and infrastructure for agents, developers and security teams.

## Tools

- [residue](https://github.com/whiteheap/residue): finds the Git worktrees coding agents leave behind, and removes one only when nothing in it would be lost. Install: `brew install whiteheap/tap/residue`
